question: For subnets whose networks are shared via RBAC action `access_as_shared` to target tenant `1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b`, group results by RBAC target tenant, IP version, and the IP-version subnet usage category (HIGH/LOW/AVERAGE). For each group, return how many matching subnet rows there are, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values (from the IPv4 subnet DNS-order variability rollup results, matched by subnet name), and the average running-sum of subnet standard attribute IDs. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each IP version as 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE'.

prediction.sql:
WITH filtered_subnets AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.name, s.ip_version, s.standard_attr_id, r.target_tenant
    FROM subnets s
    JOIN networks n ON s.network_id = n.id
    JOIN networkrbacs r ON n.id = r.object_id
    WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND r.target_tenant = '1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b'
),
ip_version_counts AS (
    SELECT ip_version, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM filtered_subnets
    GROUP BY ip_version
),
avg_ip_version_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM ip_version_counts
),
categorized_subnets AS (
    SELECT fs.id, fs.name, fs.ip_version, fs.standard_attr_id, fs.target_tenant,
           CASE 
               WHEN ics.cnt >= (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_ip_version_count) * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SUBNET_USAGE'
               WHEN ics.cnt <= (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_ip_version_count) * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SUBNET_USAGE'
               ELSE 'AVERAGE_SUBNET_USAGE'
           END as usage_category
    FROM filtered_subnets fs
    JOIN ip_version_counts ics ON fs.ip_version = ics.ip_version
),
dns_cv AS (
    SELECT s.name as subnet_name, 
           CASE WHEN AVG(dn.`order`) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE STDDEV(dn.`order`) / AVG(dn.`order`) END as cv
    FROM subnets s
    JOIN dnsnameservers dn ON s.id = dn.subnet_id
    WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    GROUP BY s.name
),
running_sums AS (
    SELECT cs.id, cs.name, cs.ip_version, cs.target_tenant, cs.usage_category,
           SUM(cs.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.ip_version ORDER BY cs.standard_attr_id) as running_sum
    FROM categorized_subnets cs
)
SELECT rs.target_tenant, rs.ip_version, rs.usage_category,
       COUNT(*) as subnet_count,
       AVG(dcv.cv) as avg_cv,
       AVG(rs.running_sum) as avg_running_sum
FROM running_sums rs
LEFT JOIN dns_cv dcv ON rs.name = dcv.subnet_name
GROUP BY rs.target_tenant, rs.ip_version, rs.usage_category

a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr AS a), SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) SELECT srs.tenant_id, srs.subnet_name, srs.avg_route_count_range, srs.avg_route_count_variance, srs.avg_route_count_stddev, pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM SubnetRouteStats AS srs CROSS JOIN WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_variance, ip_version_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.action WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort) SELECT q1.action, q1.external_status, q1.total_rows, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_stddev, ROUND(q1.total_rows / NULLIF(SUM(q1.total_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY q1.action), 0), 4) AS          STDDEV(d2.`order`) / AVG(d2.`order`) AS cv
  FROM subnets s2
  JOIN dnsnameservers d2 ON d2.subnet_id = s2.id
  WHERE s2.ip_version = 4

         SUM(s3.standard_attr_id) OVER (ORDER BY s3.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum
  FROM subnets s3
